Check Engine SEO 1.3.169

**Check Engine is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, the name of every problem, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes) to see the fix for every other problem, the ranked plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *The free result now names every problem.* Each one shows its title, how serious it is, the area it belongs to and how many pages it touches, worst first. The fix for each, the ranked plan, the markup to paste and the PDF stay in the paid version. The Buy button now also sits at the top of the free result, under the score.
- *A sale that has ended is no longer shown.* The app compares the end time of a sale with the clock every time it asks for the offer, and the sale line takes itself down when the end passes, even in a window that has been open since before. A copy left open across the end of the sale stops quoting it.
- *On Windows the desktop shortcut now says Check Engine SEO.* If you already have a desktop shortcut, the update renames it. A new interactive install still names the shortcut it offers on its last page Docket.
- *Support is support@checkengineseo.com.* The messages the app shows when a licence key is not accepted point to it.
- Nothing else changed in how audits, reports or licences work. Your licence key, settings and past reports carry over as before.

99 checks across 13 areas.
